status: Primary-documentation review only; actual staging/provider capabilities unverified

sources.supports: Storage tables represent metadata, not physical bytes; deleting SQL metadata does not delete underlying objects. File operations belong to the Storage API.
owner_id derives from the JWT subject for user-created objects. Service-key or dashboard creation can leave ownership unset. Ownership alone does not enforce access.
Service-key Storage requests bypass RLS. SQL restrictions on authenticated callers do not fence trusted service API writers.

S3 bucket versioning and object locking are not supported in the documented compatibility surface. Conditional reads are listed for HeadObject/GetObject; the DeleteObject feature row does not establish a conditional-delete guarantee.

conclusions.finding: SQL metadata absence cannot certify underlying byte deletion or safe capacity release.
A service-created object can lack owner_id; service access bypasses Storage RLS. User ownership assumptions cannot silently carry over to another upload/authentication path.
An internal storage.objects version field must not be treated as an S3 VersionId or immutable deletion precondition merely because its name is version.
No exact-version conditional-delete guarantee is established for this hosted project or the current REST SDK. Absence from a documentation feature row does not prove the capability is unsupported.
Do not switch protocols, create S3 keys, change access settings, enable purge/cleanup or invent If-Match semantics to bypass missing proof.

required_before_any_provider_probe: Prepare a narrowly scoped staging-only fixture protocol using exact source/backend identity, reviewed authentication path and explicit bounds. No existing user objects or private bytes.
Capture actual owner/id/version/hash assignment and relation between API/object metadata and bytes. Test interrupted/delayed writes without inferring physical absence from client errors.
Establish documented and observed conditional mutation behavior or keep terminal discard disabled. Conditional reads alone do not imply conditional deletes.
Define exact cleanup and independent verification first. The existing default paths-only remove adapter is not a verified exact-version cleanup capability.
Obtain fresh specific authorization before provider requests, fixtures, settings, secrets or mutation; this document is not that authorization.
